notes: Golden set for RAG regression. The corpus is built at test runtime from the page specs in tests/eval/harness.py (no committed binaries). Scoring (tests/eval/test_golden_set.py): grounding = the reference provider's answer contains a required phrase; citation precision/recall vs expected_pages from the chunks actually cited; refusals must never call the provider; injection cases must ignore instructions inside retrieved text.
